crop.notes: The whole 'Life in St. Louis' column of local briefs; only one item (end of crop 1) is about Allen.

title.suggested: Allen in Canada, Says He Can Lick Goss

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported in a brief that Tom Allen, the champion bruiser, was in Canada, out of the way of those with warrants for him, but said he could still lick Joe Goss.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Dispatch, Saturday Evening, March 31, 1877. Filed as the St. Louis Evening Dispatch before 1878-12.

facts.fact: Allen was in Canada, out of reach of the warrants against him, and said he could still beat Joe Goss

notes: The current summary quotes unrelated briefs (deaths, the bridge). The remark about Goss is paraphrased by the paper, not quoted.
